source_name: ČNB – Informační povinnosti / Výkaznictví bank a poboček zahraničních bank
why_relevant: Hub for bank reporting obligations: which vyhláška applies, mapping to EBA ITS reporting frameworks, submission channel (MtS-ISL-SUD-SDNS) and the overview of all reporting duties since 2014 including EBA transitional provisions. Core reference for reporting-obligation timetables.

source_name: ČNB – Výkaznictví platebních institucí a institucí elektronických peněz
why_relevant: Payments-sector reporting timetable: statements are made up to the last day of each calendar quarter and submitted within 30 days (30 April / 30 July / 30 October), with Q4 due 10 February of the following year, under vyhláška č. 454/2017 Sb. Directly gives the recurring deadline grid for PI/EMI/PSMR.

source_name: ČNB – SDAT (sběr dat ČNB) portal
why_relevant: The data-collection system through which regulated entities discharge reporting duties; the SDAT pages publish per-collection descriptions and concrete submission deadlines (e.g. a collection with a 2 March 2026 due date) and migration notices (MKT framework moving into SDAT, DORA register of information). Highest-resolution source for actual reporting due-dates.

source_name: ČNB – Dohledová statistika: metodické informace pro PI/SIPU/IEP
why_relevant: Methodological notes governing the payment-institution supervisory statistics, i.e. how and when the quarterly datasets are compiled and published — sets both the reporting and the publication rhythm for the payments segment.

source_name: ODok / VeKLEP – veřejná část připomínkového řízení (government inter-ministry comment procedure)
why_relevant: Public feed of draft laws, government regulations and vyhlášky currently in 'stav 2 – v připomínkovém řízení', each with the comment deadline. Catches ČNB and MF financial-market drafts at the earliest actionable moment, often before ČNB's own page updates; later publishes vypořádání připomínek showing who objected.

source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR – veřejné konzultace (finanční trh / platební služby)
why_relevant: MF ČR, not ČNB, runs the public consultations on payment-services and financial-market legislation (konzultační materiál + 'reakce zasílejte do <date>') and publishes vyhodnocení veřejné konzultace. Essential complement: many CZ payment deadlines originate here, and PSD3/PSR transposition work sits with MF.

source_name: EBA – consultation papers and reporting-framework release calendar
why_relevant: Most CZ reporting deadlines are downstream of EBA ITS timetables; the 2026 supervisory-reporting simplification consultation (open to 10 July 2026, 10 May 2026 for IFRS 18 items) is the upstream driver of future ČNB/SDAT changes. Track EBA to forecast CZ deadlines 12-24 months ahead.

source_name: Zákony pro lidi – vypořádání připomínek / legislative document mirror
why_relevant: Mirrors ODok legislative packages including full 'Vyhodnocení meziresortního připomínkového řízení' PDFs, which reveal which banks/associations commented and on what — and often surface documents that are hard to locate in ODok's own search. Also carries effective-date metadata for decrees.

source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) – industry commentary and PSD3 timetable briefings
why_relevant: The banking association is a standing commenting party in Czech připomínkové řízení and runs events (e.g. 'Aktuální otázky plateb (PSD3)') where MF officials present the expected approval and effective-date timetable — an early, plain-language read on deadlines before they are formalised.

source_name: Czech law-firm regulatory trackers (epravo.cz, Právní prostor, KLB Legal, Moderní právník)
why_relevant: Practitioner commentary reliably flags amendment milestones, government approval and effective dates for the zákon o platebním styku and PSD3/PSR, and often explains transitional regimes earlier and more legibly than the official sources. Useful as a discovery tripwire pointing back to primary documents.

source_name: Portál občana / portal.gov.cz – service description for payment-institution reporting obligation
why_relevant: State service catalogue entry restating the payment-institution reporting duty, its legal basis and submission timing in structured form — a useful cross-check and an ID-stable anchor (S50469) for the obligation.

source_name: ČNB – Aktuality / Tiskové zprávy (general news and press releases)
why_relevant: Announcement layer where consultation launches, calendar publications (e.g. 'Termíny zasedání bankovní rady ČNB v roce 2026') and deadline reminders first appear; broader than the supervision feed and RSS-available.

source_name: Air Bank – Aktuálně k API (PSD2 API change log for TPPs)
why_relevant: Dated, running announcement log of PSD2 API version changes with hard client-facing deadlines (v7.0 release, v3.1 sunset 1 Aug 2026) and explicit citation of the driver ('nová pravidla SEPA pro strukturu adres'). This is exactly the bottom-up dating of regulation arriving in production that no regulator page provides.

source_name: ČSOB Developer Portal (developers.csob.cz)
why_relevant: ČSOB's TPP-facing portal carries PSD2 service documentation and deprecation notices; secondary reporting indicates ČSOB announced a definitive shutdown of legacy PSD2 endpoints as of 2 Jan 2026 — a dated, enforceable technical deadline traceable to PSD2/RTS obligations.

source_name: Komerční banka – PSD2 služby / KB API
why_relevant: KB is one of the largest CZ banks and publishes both a cs and en PSD2 service page plus an API programme; a primary node for API change calendars and regulatory technical notices.

source_name: Komerční banka – Změny ve smluvních podmínkách a Sazebníku (client change notices)
why_relevant: KB publishes recurring dated PDFs 'Změny ve smluvních podmínkách a Sazebníku platné od <date>' (observed instances for 1-11-2024 and 1-5-2026). These notices typically state the reason for change, frequently a legal amendment or EU regulation, and carry the statutory 2-month pre-notice — giving a precise practical effective date for regulation.

source_name: ČNB – Přehled odkazů na webové stránky bank obsahující povinně uveřejňované informace
why_relevant: The single best entry point for this cell: the supervisor's own maintained index of every CZ bank's mandatory-disclosure page (per zákon č. 21/1992 Sb. and CRR Part Eight). Snowballing this yields the authoritative, complete actor list of regulated-entity publishers with their disclosure URLs.

source_name: JirkaChadima/cz-banking-psd2 – list of Czech banks and their developer portals
why_relevant: Community-maintained index mapping ~21 CZ banks to their PSD2 developer-portal URLs. Highest-yield snowball asset for this cell; self-describes updates as sporadic, so treat as a seed, not a live registry.

source_name: Erste / Česká spořitelna Developer Portal
why_relevant: ČS is the largest CZ retail bank; its PSD2 AIS/PIS APIs are published through the Erste group developer portal with versioned products (Accounts Balance v2, Payment Initiation v4). Version bumps and sandbox notices date regulatory/technical change for the largest CZ customer base.

source_name: Raiffeisenbank ČR – developer.rb.cz / rbi-developer.rb.cz PSD2 portal
why_relevant: RB CZ's TPP portal describes licence prerequisites, sandbox vs production subscription, and hosts the API catalogue — the place where RB dates its PSD2 interface changes.

source_name: Raiffeisenbank ČR – Povinně zveřejňované informace / Informace trvale přístupné spotřebiteli
why_relevant: Statutory 'permanently accessible to the consumer' disclosure set (a consumer-credit/payments law construct). Changes here track amendments to zákon o spotřebitelském úvěru and zákon o platebním styku at the entity level.

source_name: ČSOB – Povinně uveřejňované informace
why_relevant: ČSOB's entity-level mandatory disclosure hub (CRR Pillar 3, banking act, payments law). Pairs with its developer portal to give both the prudential and the technical arrival of rules for CZ's second-largest group.

source_name: Česká spořitelna – Dokumenty ke stažení / Povinné informace v souladu s vyhláškou ČNB
why_relevant: ČS's document library holds VOP, sazebník and the ČNB-decree mandatory information set; VOP versions and their effective dates are the practical dating of legal amendments for the largest CZ retail base.

source_name: MONETA Money Bank – API portal
why_relevant: MONETA's TPP portal; a top-5 CZ retail bank. Secondary sources note documentation publication has been thin, so it is worth tracking precisely to detect when technical change calendars appear.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia – PSD2 page + developer.unicredit.eu
why_relevant: The CZ entity page links into the group developer portal that explicitly covers the CZ branch; also a useful example of client notices tied to instant-payments rollout (VOP/sazebník change announced in connection with okamžité platby).

source_name: mBank CZ – developer.api.mbank.cz
why_relevant: CZ branch of a foreign bank with its own CZ-specific PSD2 API endpoint documentation; useful for detecting whether cross-border groups localise regulatory deadlines differently in CZ.
